threads.body: `opentelemetry-botocore/conformance.yaml` declares `botocore` for the same three scenario programs, so one scenario suite now reports under two different instrumented libraries. Either match the sibling with `botocore`, or change all three to `bedrock` and accept that it names the service rather than a package. (Same line in `openllmetry/conformance.yaml`.)
threads.hunk:
